The day has come at last. Perhaps the cold Hollow Vale became too much to bear?
Or was it the harsh words from the jianghu that pushed you away?
Though at Hollow Vale, we live detached from worldly matters, among us there is a bond as deep as life and death.
If you are determined to go, we won't hold you back... but it will leave an emptiness in our hearts.
No matter where your journey takes you, you will always remain an irreplaceable part of Hollow Vale.
There is one more thing I wish to tell you—
The day you first came, we all rejoiced.
Visit us from time to time, if you have time.
